info.title: Salesforce System API (SAPI)
info.description:
System API exposing core Salesforce objects for the Portfolio. This is **version 2**, selected with `X-API-Version: v2`. It returns public keys only. Version 1 is documented in `salesforce-sapi.yaml` and is deprecated (see Versioning below).

### Authentication (ADR-027)
1. **Inbound**: OAuth 2.0 **Client Credentials** issued by the Portfolio API External Client App. Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. The platform rejects missing, expired or invalid tokens before any Apex executes.
   - **Run-as identity**: a dedicated integration user holding a single read-only permission set (`Integration_Access`). Authorisation is bounded by that permission set, not by the token.
   - **Previous design**: `client_id`/`client_secret` headers validated in Apex against Custom Metadata (ADR-017, superseded). Retired when MuleSoft left the architecture.
2. **On-platform consumers**: the site API Lab proxy and the PAPI health check obtain tokens through the `Portfolio_API` Named Credential (External Credential, Client Credentials principal). No secret is stored in metadata, source, or the browser.
3. **External evaluators**: request a short-lived token from `POST /papi/v1/auth/token` (see the PAPI specification, ADR-028), then call this API with it.

### Architecture & Governance
- **Read-Only Design**: This System API is strictly read-only (GET methods only) by design to minimize attack surface and enforce unidirectional data flow.
- **ID Strategy** (ADR-038): Every record carries a stable public `key`, for example `prj_8f3k2m9qtz`, and `key` is the only identifier. Version 2 returns no `id` field and no Salesforce Id anywhere. Each reference is a key field named for its Id field in version 1 with `Id` replaced by `Key` (`projectKey`, `contactKey`). Every parameter that takes a record (`projectId`, `experienceId` and `certificationId`) takes the key only, and a Salesforce Id is treated as an unknown key. A key is set once, never changes, and never carries a name.
- **Traceability**: Each API resource maps 1:1 to an Apex `@RestResource` class (`SAPI<Resource>`), and every class runs through the shared `ApiRequestContext`.

### Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)
- **Observability**: `X-Request-Id` **mandatory** in Request/Response for distributed tracing. A missing or non-UUID value returns `400 BAD_REQUEST` (`ApiRequestContext.applyRequestRules`). The platform echoes a caller-supplied value on every response; Apex sets the header only when it generated the value (ADR-026).
- **Latency**: Target < 500ms for internal processing.
- **Resilience**: 120 requests per minute per caller key, enforced by `RateWindowLimiter` (ADR-025), with `429` responses and `Retry-After` headers. Every vended evaluator token is the same session, so all evaluators share one key and one limit of 120 per minute (ADR-028).
- **Caching Strategy**: 
  - **Public Data** (Skills, Projects, Junctions): `Cache-Control: max-age=300, public`.
  - **Private Data** (Contact, Config): `Cache-Control: max-age=300, private` or `no-store`.

### Design Constraints & Trade-offs
- **Pagination**: Offset-based pagination implemented for simplicity (<200 records). 
  - *Enterprise Note*: For volumes >2,000, this would be refactored to **Keyset/Cursor Pagination** (`WHERE Id > lastSeenId`).
- **Versioning**: Header version (`X-API-Version`) takes precedence over URL versioning, and the URL keeps its `v1` segment. Send `X-API-Version: v2` for this contract. A missing header resolves to `v1`, and any other value returns `400 BAD_REQUEST` with message `Unsupported X-API-Version` (ADR-026). Both `X-Request-Id` and `X-API-Version` are echoed on every response.
- **Version 1 sunset**: every version 1 response carries `Deprecation` and `Link` headers, and `Sunset` once the sunset date is set, 30 days after version 2 reaches production. After the sunset date version 1 answers `410 Gone` with a short message and the link to the version 2 reference, `https://ryanbumstead.com/api-reference?version=v2`.

servers.description:
Salesforce My Domain (authenticated Apex REST). Bearer-token callers use the `instance_url`
returned with their token. The Experience Cloud site domain serves Apex REST to the guest
user only, and the only guest-callable path is PAPI `POST /auth/token`.

x-rate-limit.description: Enforced in Apex by RateWindowLimiter (ADR-025), a custom-object counter: one API_Rate_Window__c row per caller key per fixed UTC calendar minute. The caller key is sapi:{SHA-256 hex of the session id}, or sapi:{user id} when the session id is null. Every response carries X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining. Request limit + 1 within the minute gets 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with Retry-After set to the seconds left in the minute. Rejected requests count. No burst allowance. Every token from POST /papi/v1/auth/token is the same session, so all evaluators share one key and one limit (ADR-028).

OAuth2ClientCredentials.description:
OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow issued by the Portfolio API External Client App (ADR-027).
Tokens run as the read-only integration user. External evaluators obtain a short-lived token
from `POST /papi/v1/auth/token` (ADR-028) instead of holding the consumer secret. Every
evaluator receives the same session, so all evaluators share one rate limit.

scopes.api: Access Salesforce REST APIs as the integration user

RequestIdResponse.description: Correlation ID. A valid caller-supplied value is echoed by the platform; Apex sets the header only when it generated the value (missing or non-UUID request header).

TotalCountResponse.description: Total number of records that match the request, so a filtered list reports the filtered total. With no filter it is every record the resource can return. The total is the same on every page of one request.

HasMoreResponse.description: Boolean indicator if more records exist beyond the current offset.

CacheControlResponse.description: Directives for caching mechanisms in both requests and responses.

NoCacheResponse.description: Directive to prevent caching of sensitive/dynamic data.

apiVersionParam.name: X-API-Version
apiVersionParam.description: API Contract Version. Send v2 for this contract. Missing resolves to v1, which is deprecated; any other value returns 400 BAD_REQUEST with message 'Unsupported X-API-Version' (ADR-026).

requestIdParam.name: X-Request-Id
requestIdParam.description: Correlation ID for distributed tracing. Required on SAPI; missing or non-UUID returns 400 BAD_REQUEST (ADR-026).

limitParam.name: limit
limitParam.description: Maximum number of records to return.

projectIdParam.name: projectId
projectIdParam.description: Filter by Project public key, for example `prj_8f3k2m9qtz`. A Salesforce Id is not accepted in v2 and is treated as an unknown key.

experienceIdParam.name: experienceId
experienceIdParam.description: Filter by Experience public key, for example `exp_4h7n2c8wpd`. A Salesforce Id is not accepted in v2 and is treated as an unknown key.

personaParam.name: persona
personaParam.description:
Filters records where the target field (Multi-Select Picklist) includes the specified persona(s).
Takes a single value or a comma-separated list of Admin, Developer and Architect. An unknown value returns 400.

Examples:
- Single: `?persona=Admin`
- Multiple (comma): `?persona=Admin,Developer`

certificationIdParam.name: certificationId
certificationIdParam.description: Filter by Certification public key, for example `crt_6q2v8d4nhz`. A Salesforce Id is not accepted in v2 and is treated as an unknown key.

categoryParam.name: category
categoryParam.description: Filter skills by Category, one of the Skill Category picklist values, for example 'Backend', 'Frontend' or 'Integration'.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request parameters or schema validation failure.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired, or invalid Bearer token (rejected by the platform before Apex executes).

Forbidden.description: The integration user lacks object, field, or Apex class permission for this resource.

NotFound.description: The requested resource ID was not found.

Retry-After.description: Seconds left in the current calendar minute, or 1 when the counter row stayed locked past the platform wait (`RateWindowLimiter.checkKey`).

retryable.description: Indicates if the client should retry the request.

correlationId.description: Unique ID tracking the request. Matches X-Request-Id.

checkType.description: SHALLOW = Runtime only. DEEP = Includes downstream dependencies.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 Timestamp of the health check.

orgTimeZone.description: Time zone of the running user (org time).

limits.description: Governor-limit snapshot of the current transaction (`SAPIHealth.buildPayload`).

(`SAPIHealth.getHealth`, payload from `SAPIHealth.buildPayload`). `checkType` is always SHALLOW.
